observations: Inspected all16study+16game combined and rider-alone native captures, both-camera combined/rider wireframes, original224front/rear obliques and same-bounds4x nearest identity details across all32headings.

Side views show actual bent thighs/knees/shins, arms/elbows and warm gripping hands. Front views foreshorten those bends naturally. Backpack remains behind the teal torso and above the seatback, with0.991304world vertical separation.

Actual contact sockets match declared hip/cushion, palm/rim and sole/floor targets below0.0001world.
